cards.answer: Fiora is a fighter and assassin who dashes into range and strikes directional Vitals for healing and movement speed. Her build focus is AD, with physical attacks and maximum-health true damage from Vitals.
cards.counterplay: Deny access to exposed Vitals and bait Riposte before committing crowd control.

cards.priority_reason: Vital positioning and Riposte define how to fight her.

cards.answer: Duelist's Dance marks a directional Vital on nearby enemy champions. Damaging a champion from that direction triggers bonus maximum-health true damage, heals Fiora, and grants her a burst of movement speed; a new Vital appears after a hit or when the previous Vital expires.
cards.counterplay: Position to keep the marked side away from Fiora.

citations.quote: Fiora identifies the Vitals of nearby enemy champions, marked as an arc around them in North-, East-, South- or Westward direction.

facts.claim: Duelist's Dance marks a directional Vital on nearby enemy champions.

citations.quote: Dealing damage in the direction of a Vital will trigger it to deal bonus true damage equal to 3% (+ 4% per 100 bonus AD) of target's maximum health, heal Fiora for 35 – 100 (based on level), and grant her 20% / 30% / 40% / 50% (based on Grand Challenge's Rank) bonus movement speed that decays over 1.85 seconds.

facts.claim: Damaging a champion from that direction triggers bonus maximum-health true damage, heals Fiora, and grants her a burst of movement speed

cards.answer: Lunge dashes in a chosen direction, then stabs a nearby enemy for physical damage and applies on-hit effects. Hitting a target reduces its cooldown.
cards.counterplay: Keep distance and protect the exposed Vital as she approaches.

citations.quote: Active: Fiora dashes in the target direction and then stabs a nearby enemy, dealing physical damage and applying on-hit effects.

facts.claim: Lunge dashes in a chosen direction, then stabs a nearby enemy for physical damage and applies on-hit effects.

cards.priority_reason: Her dash enables engagement, pursuit, and Vital access.

cards.answer: Riposte briefly prevents non-turret damage and grants debuff immunity while Fiora cannot act. Its directional stab deals magic damage and slows movement and attack speed on the first enemy champion hit; if she parries an immobilizing effect, it stuns that champion instead.
cards.counterplay: Bait the parry before using immobilizing effects, and sidestep the stab.

citations.quote: Active: Fiora enters a defensive stance for 0.75 seconds, during which she is unable to act, prevents all incoming non- turret damage, and gains debuff immunity.

facts.claim: Riposte briefly prevents non-turret damage and grants debuff immunity while Fiora cannot act.

cards.priority_reason: The parry can negate a commitment and turn crowd control into a stun.

cards.answer: Bladework empowers her next two basic attacks with bonus range and attack speed. The first slows the target, and the second critically strikes.
cards.counterplay: Create distance when she activates Bladework to limit follow-up attacks.

cards.answer: Grand Challenge reveals all four Vitals on an enemy champion and grants Fiora movement speed near them. Triggering all four, or the target dying after she triggers at least one, creates an area that continually heals Fiora and her allies.
cards.counterplay: Use nearby terrain to restrict Vital access and disengage from the marked duel.

facts.claim: Triggering all four, or the target dying after she triggers at least one, creates an area that continually heals Fiora and her allies.

cards.priority_reason: Completing the challenge can sustain Fiora and nearby allies.
